name: Bữa tối nến hồng
notes: A candlelit dinner for two (the shared grown-up couple in templates/_models: Grab3D's Casual Man and Casual Woman with Quaternius's animations, CC0; KayKit Restaurant Bits for the round table, two chairs raised to the couple's seat height, gold chargers and dinner plates; a KayKit tavern mug each). Stop 1: rose petals drift down and the table drops in piece by piece; he leads her in by the hand and pulls out her chair while she lights the three pink candles with a flick of sparks; she sits, he goes round to his seat and a menu card with the card's first words (slot note1) flips open. Stop 2: two mugs drop from the sky into their hands, they clink and sip, and the card's photo slides along the string lights on a clothes peg with its caption (slot caption). Stop 3: the plates vanish, a heart-shaped cake rises out of the table, they stand and cheer under heart-shaped fireworks, a banner with the last words (slot note2) rises, their mugs vanish in a sparkle and they end side by side behind the cake, cheek to cheek. The next tap opens the letter. The act is the shared templates/_acts/lovestory.js; this card's own moves are in story.js.
